name: Miro Enoteca
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Miro Enoteca in Kufstein**

Discover a world of fine wines and authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of **Tirol**. At **Miro Enoteca**, we invite you to indulge in a refined dining experience where every dish is crafted with passion and every glass of wine tells a story.

Our cozy yet elegant atmosphere makes it the perfect spot to unwind after exploring the charming old town of **Kufstein** or the breathtaking landscapes of the **Kaisergebirge**. Whether you're craving handmade pasta, a perfectly grilled steak, or a selection of our carefully curated wines, our menu offers something for every palate.

Join us for lunch, dinner, or an intimate aperitivo—where good food, great wine, and warm hospitality come together.

**Miro Enoteca – Where Italian flair meets Tirol’s charm.**
